body:
Review pass 40. Three original-review findings closed in one stretch. Verified all three rather than reading the notes.

1. bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 CLOSED and correct. .dense_double_matrix_bytes replaces the allocate-to-measure preflight and is exact on every shape including 1x1 (12x50000, 200x20000, 3x10, 1x1 all identical to object.size). The two per-feature-block calls inside the loop are gone; the three remaining are outside the hot path (one not in a loop, one once per partition on a list of matrices, one in the benchmark harness). Proportionate.

2. PRINT METHODS - 26 S3method entries in NAMESPACE, where my first review counted ZERO. I re-ran the exact pass-1 reproduction that dumped closures and environments to the console. Then:

     $total$read
     function(rows = NULL) ...
     <environment: 0x1219eaeb8>

   Now:

     <effect_geometry>
       effects:      3 x 3
       measurements: 6
       components:   total + coherent + configuration
       storage:      memory
       estimate:     signed cross-generalized form; PSD not assumed

   That last line is the part I would single out - the scientific caveat is now surfaced at the console rather than buried in a receipt. contrast() prints a labelled data frame with coherence_fraction. This was the first thing I flagged as what every user would see, and it is fixed.

3. as_neurovol() - the volume out-path I flagged as absent ("no NIfTI in, no NIfTI out; you write the array() line yourself"). Verified round-trip on a masked 6x6x4 volume: class DenseNeuroVol, exact values back (max|diff| 0), outside-mask voxels correctly NA under the default fill, spacing 3x3x3 preserved.

So of the user-facing complaints in the original review, print/format, the export path, and the preflight allocation are all now addressed and checked. Remaining from that review: examples in Rd (still none) and a README first sentence aimed at an fMRI reader.

Open beads: bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX (MC test 1% headroom), bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT (degenerate gate fixture - now cheap to fix with 1677 s of headroom), bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8 (scale gates never run in CI), bd-01KZXJMDRC6VKYX6SA38R0AAH1 (subtraction receipt), bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED (uncommitted tree), bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D (resolved, closure recommended).
